EV-O-E15 restates that each idempotency key is retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-I15 restates automatic dead-letter placement after the final unsuccessful attempt and that a dead-lettered job is not executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.
EV-O-J15 restates that five dead-letter events for one tenant in any rolling thirty-minute window raise an operator escalation, counting the new event.
EV-O-K15 restates that FIFO order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition, with no ordering between partitions.
EV-O-L15 restates that audit history remains queryable for one month, defined as thirty calendar days from recording.
EV-O-A16 caps each job at one original execution plus at most three retries, which is the same maximum-attempts locus as ADDR-16170108e75cf515.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A16 restates that one original execution may be followed by at most three retries and that the job must not run again after those retries fail, matching a maximum of four total executions.
EV-O-C16 caps an individual execution at half a minute and the example stops work at 08:15:30, restating a 30-second timeout.
EV-O-C16 requires an execution stopped at the time limit to be recorded as a failed attempt.
EV-O-B16 restates a fixed five-second wait from the end of the failed attempt before every retry, independent of attempt number.
EV-O-F16 grants ownership for one and a half minutes from delivery, restating a 90-second lease duration.
EV-O-G16 restates renewal when twenty seconds of lease life remain if work is progressing, and forbids renewing the same lease more than once every fifteen seconds.
EV-O-G16 restates that a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.
EV-O-H16 restates that cancellation starts no future attempts and does not interrupt an already running attempt, which runs to completion, failure, or timeout.
EV-O-D16 restates ignore-on-same-id-and-key versus reject-as-conflict on same id with a different idempotency key, without changing the active job.
EV-O-E16 restates that each idempotency key is retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-I16 requires the job to remain failed for operator review and forbids automatically moving it to the dead-letter queue.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must leave the job in the failed state requiring operator review before further action, and must not automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue.

drafts.reason: EV-O-I16 replaces automatic dead-lettering after the last failed attempt with leaving the job in the failed state for operator review.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J16 restates that five dead-letter events for one tenant in any rolling thirty-minute window raise an operator escalation, counting the new event.
EV-O-K16 restates that FIFO order is guaranteed only within a queue partition and not across partitions.
EV-O-L16 restates that audit history remains queryable for thirty calendar days from recording and may be deleted afterward.
